cohort: The study included 632 neonates admitted to a neonatal intensive care unit in Iraq between April and September 2022.
finding: The NICU mortality rate was 23.9%, primarily driven by prematurity and respiratory distress syndrome, with deceased neonates having significantly lower gestational age and birth weight.
mod_finding: Newborns delivered vaginally had a 4.11 times higher likelihood of poor outcomes compared to cesarean deliveries.
birth_weight: Deceased neonates had significantly lower birth weight (P<0.001).
gest_age: Deceased neonates had significantly lower gestational age (P<0.001).
